description: This source file implements the VP8OnlyEncoderFactory class, which wraps an existing VideoEncoderFactory to restrict supported formats to VP8 only, and provides methods to create encoders and retrieve supported formats and encoder selectors.

classes.name: VP8OnlyEncoderFactory
classes.description: A factory class that wraps another VideoEncoderFactory to restrict supported formats to VP8 only.

methods.name: VP8OnlyEncoderFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with an inner VideoEncoderFactory.

methods.name: GetSupportedFormats
methods.description: Returns a list of supported video formats, filtered to include only VP8.

methods.name: CreateVideoEncoder
methods.description: Creates a video encoder for the specified format by delegating to the inner factory.

methods.name: GetEncoderSelector
methods.description: Retrieves the encoder selector interface from the inner factory.
